Херојот од Дебар маало (The Hero from Debar Quart) | founded = {{Start date and age|df=yes|1937|10|4}} | ground = [[Toše Proeski Arena|National Arena Toše Proeski]] | capacity = 33,011 | supporters = | chairman = Goran Popovski | manager = Bazhe Janakievski | league = [[Macedonian Second Football League|Macedonian Second League]] | season = [[2025–26 Macedonian First Football League|2025–26]] | position = [[Macedonian First Football League|Macedonian First League]], 11th of 12 (relegated) | pattern_la1 = _white_stripes | pattern_b1 = _jomainter19rw | pattern_ra1 = _white_stripes | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = FF0000 | body1 = FF0000 | rightarm1 = FF0000 | shorts1 = FF0000 | socks1 = FF0000 | pattern_la2 = _academy2wr | pattern_b2 = _academy2wr | pattern_ra2 = _academy2wr | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = FFFFFF | socks2 = FFFFFF | pattern_ra3 = _jomagold5rb | pattern_b3 = _jomagold5rb | pattern_la3 = _jomagold5rb | leftarm3 = 0042FF | body3 = 0042FF | rightarm3 = 0042FF | shorts3 = 0042FF | socks3 = 0042FF | website = {{URL|http://fkrabotnicki.com/}} }} {{Rabotnichki sections}} '''FK Rabotnichki''' ({{langx|mk|ФК Работнички}}), commonly known as '''Rabotnichki''' and occasionally by the nickname "The Romantics" ({{langx|mk|Романтичари}}), is a professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Skopje]], [[North Macedonia]]. Founded on 4 October 1937, the club plays its home matches at the [[Toše Proeski Arena]], the country's largest stadium, which they share with their city rivals [[FK Vardar]] and the [[North Macedonia national football team]].{{cite web |url=http://stadiumdb.com/stadiums/mkd/arena_filip_ii_makedonski |title=Nacionalna Arena Toše Proeski |website=StadiumDB |access-date=2026-02-26}} They currently compete in the [[Macedonian Second Football League]]. Considered one of the most successful clubs in Macedonian football history, Rabotnichki has won the Macedonian First League title four times (2004–05, 2005–06, 2007–08, and 2013–14) and the [[Macedonian Football Cup]] four times (2007–08, 2008–09, 2013–14, and 2014–15).{{cite web |url=http://macedonianfootball.com/rabotnichki-clinches-first-league-trophy-video/ |title=Rabotnichki clinches First League trophy |website=Macedonian Football |date=2014-05-11 |access-date=2026-02-26}} The club achieved the domestic "Double" (winning both the league and cup in the same season) on two occasions, in 2007–08 and 2013–14. On the continental stage, Rabotnichki has frequently represented North Macedonia in [[UEFA]] competitions. The club reached the play-off round of the [[UEFA Europa League]] twice: in the 2011–12 season, where they were eliminated by [[S.S. Lazio|Lazio]], and in the 2015–16 season, where they fell to [[FC Rubin Kazan|Rubin Kazan]] after eliminating [[Trabzonspor]].{{cite web |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/history/clubs/75797--rabotnicki/ |title=Rabotnicki UEFA History |website=UEFA.com |access-date=2026-02-26}} The club maintains a fierce rivalry with FK Vardar, known as the "Neighborhood Derby," as both clubs are situated in central Skopje and share the same home ground. While Rabotnički enjoyed a resurgence in the 2024–25 season by finishing third and qualifying for the [[UEFA Conference League]], the 2025–26 campaign proved challenging; as of February 2026, the team was positioned in the relegation zone of the First League table.{{cite web |url=https://tribuna.com/en/clubs/rabotnicki/standings/ |title=Rabotnički Standings 2024/2025 & Table |website=Tribuna.com |access-date=2026-02-26}}{{dead link|date=May 2026|bot=medic}}{{cbignore|bot=medic}}{{cite web |url=https://int.soccerway.com/matches/2026/02/20/macedonia-fyr/first-league/akademija-pandev/fk-rabotnicki/4384660/ |title=Brera Strumica vs. Rabotnicki - 20 February 2026 |website=Soccerway |date=2026-02-20 |access-date=2026-02-26}}"}}
